title: Apply for a native animal import/export licence
summary: Apply for a native animal import/export licence required for transporting native animals into and out of NSW.
intro: If you want to transport native animals into and out of NSW, you'll need to apply for a native animal import/export licence. You can apply for this licence online.
who_can_apply: Licensed NSW animal keepers and animal dealers (to facilitate interstate dealing)
Individuals involved in interstate movements of native animals for scientific research
Wildlife rehabilitation groups, zoos, wildlife parks, and tourist attractions (holding native animals for interstate movement)
what_you_need: The name, contact details, and licence or permit details of the interstate party
The species code as identified in the NSW Native Animal Keepers' Species List

how_to_steps.text: Log in or create an account.
Follow the prompts to apply for a native animal import/export licence.
You'll get a transaction receipt within 4 hours of applying.
You'll be notified of the outcome of your application within 28 days.

faqs.q: Who can apply for this licence?
faqs.a: Licensed NSW animal keepers and animal dealers can apply to facilitate interstate dealing. Licences are also for interstate movements of native animals used for scientific research, and those held by wildlife rehabilitation groups, zoos, wildlife parks, and tourist attractions.

faqs.q: How long will it take to get the licence?
faqs.a: You will receive a transaction receipt within 4 hours of applying, and you will be notified of the outcome of your application within 28 days.

faqs.q: Where can I find more information about the process?
faqs.a: To ensure you have all the necessary information and documents, visit the Department of Planning and Environment.
